name: absolute-note
description: Persistent sticky notes on any web page (Chrome and Firefox, Manifest V3).

scripts.lint: eslint . && npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --overwrite-dest --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist/packages --filename absolute-note-firefox-{version}.zip && web-ext build --overwrite-dest --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir dist/packages --filename absolute-note-chrome-{version}.zip
